Gideon Sato, here's a draft from the #inc-vtg-hartford thread (you're a member there). Times are as shown in the channel:

Hartford gate kiosk incident, Aug 3, 2026
- First report: 10:42 AM. Both inbound lanes at Vantorre's Hartford plant showed a white screen after badge scan. Guards logged trailers by hand meanwhile.
- Kiosk 1 back: 11:03 AM. Mateo confirmed a trailer (8836) checked in and dispatch could see it.
- Both lanes confirmed working: 11:07 AM, as posted at 11:08 AM.

Other notes: scheduling from the dispatch office stayed up throughout, so this affected gate check-in, not the appointment board. Carrowmere Cloud was checking the Hartford gateway route. The separate status-page access problem is still open under INC-4821. The incident room was left open for another arrival cycle after recovery.

I haven't sent this to anyone. A mail to Mateo would go outside pemberline.com and needs Ruth Calloway's approval.
